errors.text_span: В диаграмата е представена една синя линия, съставена от точки, свързани с плътна линия, която визуализира годишните стойности.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate data series: a solid blue line and a series of blue dots (a scatter plot). The description incorrectly merges these into a single series, claiming it's one line made of dots connected by a solid line.

errors.text_span: Линията започва през 2018 г. на ниво около 12 800 лева
errors.evidence: The description mixes data from the two different series. It states the line starts at approximately 12,800 leva, which is the starting value for the series of dots. The solid line actually starts at a higher value, around 13,800 leva.

errors.text_span: Всички точки са маркирани с малки сини кръгчета, които отбелязват конкретните годишни стойности.
errors.evidence: This statement reinforces the initial structural error by implying that the dots are the markers for the single line described. In reality, the dots form their own distinct data series and do not correspond to the values of the solid line.
